description: OVERVIEW Vibescape is an inter-college vibe coding event organized by MACSTAK – The Tech Society of MAC, Department of Computer Science, Maharaja Agrasen College, University of Delhi. EVENT DETAILS Date: 7 October 2026 Time: 11:00 AM Onwards Venue: Maharaja Agrasen College, Vasundhara Enclave, New Delhi, Delhi 110096 Participation: Team-wise / Individual Maximum team size: 2 members REGISTRATION — IMPORTANT Step 1: Register on Unstop to access the event listing. Step 2 : Complete the official VibEscape ’26 Google Form to finalize your registration. Official Google Form: https://forms.gle/9f4UD9VvzAfPW9Kf7 Your registration will be considered complete only after submitting the Google Form. ELIGIBILITY: Inter-college participation is allowed. Participants must bring their valid College ID. Each team can have a maximum of 2 members. Team members must remain the same throughout all three rounds. EVENT FORMAT: The event consists of three rounds — a Quiz, a Vibe Build challenge, and The Twist, where participants modify their project according to a new requirement. AI tools are not permitted in Round 3. RULES: Participants may use only Claude and Gemini for AI-assisted work. ChatGPT and all other AI tools are strictly prohibited. Only the free versions of Claude and Gemini are permitted. Paid, Pro, Max, Advanced or other premium plans/models are not allowed. Participants must use the accounts/IDs provided by the organizers and may not log in using personal accounts. Google Search may be used for documentation, images and other non-AI resources. Phones and other personal digital devices are not permitted inside the lab. Participants are responsible for managing their Claude and Gemini usage limits. The organizers will not be responsible for usage-limit restrictions or exhaustion. Team members must remain unchanged throughout all three rounds. Participants must bring their College ID.

raw.details:
OVERVIEW

Vibescape is an inter-college vibe coding event organized by MACSTAK – The Tech Society of MAC, Department of Computer Science, Maharaja Agrasen College, University of Delhi.

EVENT DETAILS

  • Date: 7 October 2026
  • Time: 11:00 AM Onwards
  • Venue: Maharaja Agrasen College, Vasundhara Enclave, New Delhi, Delhi 110096
  • Participation: Team-wise / Individual
  • Maximum team size: 2 members

REGISTRATION — IMPORTANT

Step 1: Register on Unstop to access the event listing.
Step 2: Complete the official VibEscape ’26 Google Form to finalize your registration.

Official Google Form:
https://forms.gle/9f4UD9VvzAfPW9Kf7

Your registration will be considered complete only after submitting the Google Form.

ELIGIBILITY:

  • Inter-college participation is allowed.
  • Participants must bring their valid College ID.
  • Each team can have a maximum of 2 members.
  • Team members must remain the same throughout all three rounds.

EVENT FORMAT:

The event consists of three rounds — a Quiz, a Vibe Build challenge, and The Twist, where participants modify their project according to a new requirement. AI tools are not permitted in Round 3.

RULES:

  • Participants may use only Claude and Gemini for AI-assisted work.
  • ChatGPT and all other AI tools are strictly prohibited.
  • Only the free versions of Claude and Gemini are permitted. Paid, Pro, Max, Advanced or other premium plans/models are not allowed.
  • Participants must use the accounts/IDs provided by the organizers and may not log in using personal accounts.
  • Google Search may be used for documentation, images and other non-AI resources.
  • Phones and other personal digital devices are not permitted inside the lab.
  • Participants are responsible for managing their Claude and Gemini usage limits. The organizers will not be responsible for usage-limit restrictions or exhaustion.
  • Team members must remain unchanged throughout all three rounds.
  • Participants must bring their College ID.
